item.title: Pretend you’re sitting at Elizabeth Holmes’ desk on this weirdly detailed website
item.description:
With over a thousand emails, slides, texts, and documents unveiled during the United States v. Elizabeth Holmes trial, Extend engineer Bo Lau created a website that simulates what it might have been like to be the chief executive of Theranos before everything came crashing down. (Every day, I am grateful to the American legal system for making the discovery process public.)
i built a website where you can sit at elizabeth holmes’ desk
open her macbook, scroll her iphone, run the theranos edison machine
her texts, emails, slides, documents, and theranos machine records are real, sourced from exhibits in the united states v.

item.title: Japan Sees Sharp Rise in Web Data Leaks Amid Mobile API Abuse and Metabase Attacks
item.description: Attackers behind a string of personal data leaks at Japanese organizations have abused APIs for mobile apps and targeted known software flaws, the JPCERT Coordination Center (JPCERT/CC) said. The Tokyo-based center, which takes incident reports, based its October 8, 2026 alert on those reports and other information. The alert names no attacker and no affected organization.
